body.message:
Are you kidding me?

The leak is still there. It stops for a while and then starts dripping again. I’m really tired of this.

I can’t properly use the bathroom because water keeps dripping from the ceiling. If there’s no leak, then why is the floor wet? The dripping continues throughout the night until morning.

Your team’s assessment does not reflect the actual situation. This issue has been ongoing for weeks and needs to be fixed properly.
